content: HTMLMediaElement.playbackRate is Baseline Widely available (since July 2015; Chrome 4+, Safari 3.1+, iOS Safari 3.2+, Android WebView/Chrome Android all supported). WebKit bug 55943 (play() resetting playbackRate to defaultPlaybackRate) was FIXED in 2011 - spec now only resets on built-in UI play. Audio auto-mutes outside ~0.25-4.0 range in Gecko; pitch corrected by default (preservesPitch). Negative rates not portable. For subtle degradation use 0.8-1.0 range.
